comment: Dr. Leatherman is a phenomenal professor and the ideal person to teach the introductory course for the MHRM program.  He is fair, clearly states his expectations, and is genuinely concerned about the success of his students.  He has a perfect blend of lecture vs group activities and allows us to apply the material to our everyday lives.

Dr. D is a wonderful professor who truly cares about his students. If you ask for help he will give you all the tools you need for success -- it may not be easy, but you always feel like you actually learned something by the end of class.
